'''This''' was an alien species that resembled a huge black fly. Two of these beings were young students at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] along with [[Anakin Solo]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]. These students were able to lift their two-kilo weight with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and buzzed happily, despite being weaker in the Force than Anakin, as the latter was initially unable to levitate the weight and wondered why they could and he could not.
